Frequently asked questions

How much does delivery cost?

Delivery is available anywhere in Jordan for a flat fee of 2 JOD.

How long does an order take?

Most custom pieces are ready within a few days, depending on size and finish.

Can I send my own design or idea?

Yes — send a reference photo, sketch, or description on WhatsApp and we'll quote it for you.

Can you match a specific color?

Most colors can be matched or closely matched — we'll confirm the exact shade with you before printing.

How do I pay?

Reach out on WhatsApp or by phone and we'll confirm payment details with you directly.
